chapters.title: Chapter 1. I had a cat once.
Chapter 2. Chess sucked. It was the worst, most confusing and boring game ever. But my sister and Oryn did not need to know that.
Chapter 3. Sometimes, I talk to the shadows. It is easier than talking to people. Maybe because they don't reply.
Chapter 4. I fear I might be blind to my own violence.
Chapter 6. I've been killing him in my dreams, too. For ten years now. And in them, he kills me, too.
Chapter 7. I wasn't hiding in the library. I knew she'd easily find me there.
Chapter 8. Every hand reaching for me looks like it has claws. Truth is, I don't mind being touched. Only scarred.
Chapter 9. I let her haunt me in my dreams even though I do not dream, even though I can easily not dream.
Chapter 11. I can't remember what scares me most. Only that I am terrified it. Pain haunts me sometimes more than memories.
Chapter 13. I'd been drowning for so long that I no longer felt the ocean around me. Something was suffocating me, I just didn't know what.
Chapter 15. I liked the darkness. Only because I could wonder if he was there or not. And often, I liked to think that he was.
Chapter 16. Pink was my favourite colour. Only because it was hard to describe the exact shade of honey his eyes turned in sunlight.
Chapter 17. I had a complicated relationship with faith. She deserved better worshipers.
Chapter 18. I burned Rain's old toy and lied that we forgot it in Hellas. But that was before I found out she had more of the same. And now it feels as if they are all haunting me for revenge.
Chapter 19. I had missed him. I even missed him when he was here.
Chapter 21. I loved his tiny waist. And his big, muscular thighs when they were squeezed by his tight leathers. And...a few other things.

Chapter 22. I helped Elias pick a ring for Visha. It was big and pretty and sparkly. And had a huge emerald at the centre. It would surely bruise him if she said no and threw it at him. Which was highly likely.
Chapter 23. I knew about the fucking ghost. But I was still mad she didn't tell me about it first. Very hurt, too.
Chapter 24. She was too much like me. And I almost feared for her.
Chapter 25. The fucking tea did not work.

Chapter 26. On the third shelf on the dresser, there is where I kept all her bows. They were right under where she had found the bottles of liquor. Luckily, she had not found out about my other sick addiction. Yet.
Chapter 27. She scares me a little. Frankly, she scares me a lot.
Chapter 28. I still thought the world was ending. Maybe I still do.
Chapter 29. I was going to kill Elias Venzor.
Chapter 30. I might have considered letting her tie me up with her ridiculous pink bows.
Chapter 31. I was scared. And this time I knew what I was scared of. That somehow scared me even worse.
Chapter 32. I knew that Isjord was mine before Snow handed me the crown.
Chapter 33. I was fairly sure Rain and her dolls had some agenda against me.
Chapter 34. They were just three words. But it was so difficult to give them to him because I was scared I would never get them back.
Chapter 37. Part of me had always known. But maybe it was too scared to acknowledge that I needed him so much.
Chapter 38. I'd begged the Demon God. And he'd taken pity on me. Hellas was the only place where I knew that could keep me from her.
Chapter 39. I would have lost something if not for him. One way or another. I would have lost my mind or soul even if I won.
Chapter 40. It was like that. It had always been like that. Maybe since the very start when I'd seen his eyes and trusted the shadows behind with my truths even though I didn't know them.

Chapter 41. Part of me felt like I'd failed my nephews and niece. Part of me was still so afraid for them. Some other part of me was relieved that she and I never had the chance to have our own family. I was not as strong as my brother.
Chapter 42. I wanted what my sister had. And I wanted to have that with him. There would never be anyone if it wasn't with him.
Bonus Content: A Lord's Guide to a Grumpy Witch's Heart.
